All four files are written. Let me verify citation token integrity and structural requirements.

Let me clean up one awkward citation phrase in chapter 10.

Four chapters written to `languages/python_guide/`, all passing the shared contract.

| File | Bytes | `samples/…:LINE` citations | Tables | Unique source URLs |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| `10-logging-and-observability.md` | 6,548 | 35 | 2 | 6 |
| `11-async-and-concurrency.md` | 6,946 | 40 | 3 | 7 |
| `12-iterators-generators-deep.md` | 6,927 | 38 | 3 | 6 |
| `13-performance-measurement.md` | 6,178 | 28 | 2 | 6 |

Every citation token resolves to an existing captured file and an in-range line; all fences are tagged and ≤25 lines; first lines and terminal `## Sources` sections conform. No TODO/placeholder text or coverage claims.

**Measured / derived boundary used**

- **Measured (documented, line-cited):** all API behaviour, defaults, version gates and semantics — e.g. logging levels and `LoggerAdapter`/`taskName` (`library__logging.rst`), `TaskGroup`/`timeout` (`whatsnew__3.11.rst`), GIL/free-threading status (`library__threading.rst`, `whatsnew__3.13/3.14.rst`), iterator/generator and `yield from` semantics (`howto__functional.rst`, `reference__expressions.rst`), `timeit` min-not-mean guidance and the 3.15 `profile` deprecation/aliasing (`library__timeit.rst`, `library__profile.rst`, `whatsnew__3.15.rst`).
- **Derived:** engineering advice layered on those facts (lazy-argument logging, structured formatters, correlation-id/redaction hooks, bounded queues for backpressure, `aclose()` discipline, warmup, fixed-tolerance CI gates) — always labelled `derived` with the supporting citation in the same sentence.
- **Not verified:** `contextvars` API details, a stdlib JSON logging handler, measured logging overhead, the `tracemalloc` API (no capture exists — only a passing mention at `whatsnew__3.13.rst:2221`), and pyperf/structlog/pytest plugins.
- **Wiki, lower authority:** community claims from `language__Concurrency.html` and `performance__PythonSpeed.html` (including the CPython 2.4 caveat on string concatenation), explicitly marked as such.

No files outside the four assignments were modified.
